title: Flat localization in the second derived tensor factor
statement: Let $R\to A$ and $R\to B$ be maps of commutative rings, let $C$ be a flat localization of $B$, and let $M$ be a complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-derived-category]. For every $i$, the canonical map $H^i(M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}B)\otimes_B C\to H^i(M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}C)$ is an isomorphism of $A\otimes_R C$-modules, natural in $M$ and compatible with the derived-category actions of $A$ and $B$. It is also compatible with the comparison maps: the square formed by $H^i$ of the canonical comparison map $M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}B\to M\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}(A\otimes_R B)$ tensored with $C$, $H^i$ of the comparison map $M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}C\to M\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}(A\otimes_R C)$, the above isomorphism, and the canonical map $H^i(M\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}(A\otimes_R B))\otimes_B C\to H^i(M\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}(A\otimes_R C))$ commutes.
